title: Mitsubishi Electric to Develop Cryogenic Amplifiers for Quantum Computers: Supporting Chips Are Key to Scaling Up
excerpt: On September 17, 2026, Mitsubishi Electric announced the start of R&D on cryogenic amplifiers and other technologies for quantum computers. A beginner-friendly look at the role of microwave ICs, the challenges of cooling and heat, the NEDO project schedule, and the performance to watch for.
